questions.question: Which palette and CTA style should commerce pages use?
questions.reason: Commerce pages need a business-approved brand layer instead of silent template defaults. Missing brand.commerce_palette_source or brand.cta_style.

questions.question: Which product variants or colors are actually sold, and may media show other variants?
questions.reason: Variant ambiguity often creates wrong-color carousels and unavailable-product claims. Detected multiple variant/media signals: air harmony odor vaporizer, air purifier ionic plug-in, foot massager, fruit and veg cleaner.

questions.question: How should bundle cards present pricing: simple unit price, savings-led, or full accounting?
questions.reason: CampaignSpec owns prices; the brief owns which shopper-facing price story is appropriate. Missing offer_presentation.bundle_cards.primary_price.

questions.question: Which promo, savings, and urgency language is approved for timers, banners, and exit-pop surfaces?
questions.reason: Promo placeholders and unsupported scarcity claims are business decisions, not implementation details. CampaignSpec appears to include promo/offer signals, but promo copy authority is incomplete.
